name: Quick Pill 5.6.1
changelog: Optimization: Quiet Idle Architecture - eliminated wmic, powershell, and reg external process loops during idle mode, dropping idle CPU usage to 0.0%.
Feature: Native Win32 device notification (WM_DEVICECHANGE) for instant USB detection without polling.
Performance: Suspended non-essential background timers (Camera, Mic, Notifications, Bluetooth) while collapsed in Still Mode.
Stability: Restored clean, reliable Electron runtime with zero WebView2 crash/hover issues.
CI/CD: Automated GitHub Actions release pipeline for Electron installer.
